# Key London-wide checks

```{python}
data = pd.read_parquet(PROCESSED_DIRECTORY / "greater_london_rents_dataset.parquet")

# Residential units (2011, 2021)
data["is_residential_2011"].sum() # 3481425
data["is_residential_2021"].sum() # 3817983

# Private rental units (2011, 2021)
data["private_rented_2011"].sum() # 878,151
data["private_rented_2021"].sum() # 1,174,022

# Matched rental listings (all)
data.filter(regex="^listed_rent_").notna().any(axis=1).sum() # 648652

# Average estimated rent (2011, 2021)
data.loc[data["private_rented_2011"] == True, "est_rent_2011"].mean() / 12
# 1599.996
data.loc[data["private_rented_2021"] == True , "est_rent_2021"].mean() / 12
# 2006.774
```
